Frontend end-to-end flow: register -> auto-login -> create courses (2) -> tabs (PDF/Links/Notes) -> add link -> notes autosave indicator -> logout -> re-login -> courses persist. All primary flows working.

UI create course via sidebar appears in list
UI add link via link-form shows in list
UI PDF dropzone renders on PDFler tab
UI existing-user login redirects to dashboard
